newsitem.title: LEBANON: Economic activity picks up slightly in April.
newsitem.headline: Economic activity picks up slightly in April.

text.p: Lebanon's economic activity picked up in April to its highest level in five months, the Bank of Lebanon said on Tuesday.

The central bank's monthly report said its coincident indicator of economic activity rose to 170.3 in April up from 166.0 in March, well above last April's 150.1 when Israel launched a 17-day blitz on the country.
"The BDL coincident indicator suggests a slight pick-up in economic activity, in part seasonal," the bank said.

The indicator, which takes January 1993 as 100, combines 12 economic series including imports, exports, electricity output and airport and port activity. The bank has not revealed the weighting of the different series and some economists question its value.

The bank created the indicator to fill a gap caused by a lack of reliable date in Lebanon since the 1975-90 civil war, which prevents precise calculation of Gross Domestic Product and economic growth.
